title: Chariots of fire as angelic vehicles

tellings.quote: However, in the narrative, you have these other vehicles that are called the chariots of God or the chariots of Israel or the chariots of fire.

plain: The Bible describes vehicles called "the chariots of God or the chariots of Israel or the chariots of fire," and these can be read as craft used by angels. Tim Alberino, a guest who came on the show to tell of a giant he says was captured in Afghanistan, offers this reading of the biblical stories himself. If he is right, ancient scripture would be describing flying vehicles.
